title: 周回顾抽查 #1 · 被动语态 / 现在完成时 / 将来完成时
topic: 每周回顾（随机抽近期知识点，防遗忘）
goal: 周回顾抽查：从近期学过的知识点里随机抽 3 个（被动语态、现在完成时、将来完成时），检验是否还记得。错题会重新揪出来练。

questions.prompt: The new library ____ (build) in the city centre last year, and it has been open ever since.
questions.explanation: last year → 一般过去时；library 被建造 → 被动 was built。

questions.prompt: She ____ (work) as a nurse for ten years, and she is still on the same ward today.
questions.explanation: for ten years + 现在仍持续（still）→ 现在完成时 has worked，强调从过去延续到现在的状态。

questions.prompt: By the time the exam results are announced, most of the candidates ____ already left the country.
questions.explanation: by + 将来时间点 → 将来完成时 will have done（到那时已经离开）。

questions.prompt: The report ____ by the committee last month, but no one has read it yet.
questions.explanation: last month 是明确的过去时间点 → 一般过去时被动 was submitted；后半句的 now 状态才用现在完成时。
